svg.aria-label: The electron transport chain in the inner mitochondrial membrane. NADH gives electrons to complex I and FADH2 (from succinate turning into fumarate) gives electrons to complex II. A red line traces the electrons through coenzyme Q, complex III, cytochrome c and complex IV to oxygen, which forms water. Complexes I, III and IV pump H+ from the matrix into the intermembrane space; H+ flows back through ATP synthase, which makes ATP from ADP and phosphate.
